holdout-splits.title: Fit, choose and test without crossing the boundary
holdout-splits.summary: Arrows show which data may influence fitting, threshold selection and final reporting. Test labels influence only the final report. The dates of all training outcomes precede the next partition in this fictional fixture.

nodes.label: 144 training tickets
nodes.description: Earlier tickets supply intake features and mature labels. Training cross-validation also stays inside these rows.

nodes.label: Fitted pipeline
nodes.description: Training rows fit imputation, category encoding, scaling and classifier coefficients.

nodes.label: 48 validation tickets
nodes.description: The fitted pipeline predicts these rows. Their labels choose a threshold by the declared cost.

nodes.label: Frozen model and threshold
nodes.description: The selected threshold and fitted model stop changing before final evaluation.

nodes.label: 48 final test tickets
nodes.description: The final rows supply new intake inputs and mature answers for the report. They never fit a preprocessing step or choose the threshold.

nodes.label: Model and baseline report
nodes.description: Compare both procedures on the same final rows. Include confusion counts, costs and the fictional-data limit.

steps.title: Fit using earlier rows
steps.explanation: A fit learns every transformation and the classifier using training data only. Within cross-validation, each earlier training fold gets its own fitted pipeline.

steps.title: Select the action threshold
steps.explanation: The validation probabilities stay fixed while thresholds change. The declared cost chooses one threshold; validation rows do not refit the model.

steps.title: Report one frozen comparison
steps.explanation: Final labels contribute only to metrics. If those metrics prompt another model change, use new held-out data for the next final assessment.
